title: The REAL Story On Why Space Cadet Pinball Was Removed (ft. Windows on Itanium)
summary: NCommander investigates why Space Cadet Pinball disappeared from Windows Vista, building on Raymond Chen's explanation about 64-bit incompatibility. He tests it on 64-bit Windows including Itanium and walks through the debugging.
why: Recommended as the detailed, entertaining history of why 3D Pinball vanished from Windows.

quote.text: If you have the time, I highly recommend checking out the NCommander's video talking about Space Cadet Pinball.
